title: RAW UNREVIEWED: latent source words must form a path through attested directed word pairs
summary: Retain the specific new GDT1418 contract: replace arbitrary concatenation of words from a fixed vocabulary W by a nonempty path through its attested directed source-word graph. Source word boundaries remain latent, native visible gaps are not assumed to be those boundaries, and one global injective working-unit/source-codepoint key covers the complete stream. This adds a real source-order restriction without claiming grammar, plaintext identity or a complete native layout writer.

controlling_documents.ownership: These are root-owned experiment documents. This proposal is a design-navigation card, not a replacement preregistration, implementation instruction or result assessment.

design.source_graph: For each unchanged source independently, W contains every original token, including one-character and isolated words. E contains ordered adjacent token pairs only within the same old1177record,1228source_section or1290PRIMARYsentence_index. No edge crosses those record boundaries. Unicode, case, punctuation, tokens and the source inventory stay unchanged. No source file was opened by this producer.
design.source_message_domain: A nonempty ordered sequence w1,...,wm with each wi in W and every pair (wi,wi+1) in E. The first and last words may be any W members; there are no forced source-section start/end words or virtual resets inside the message. A one-word sequence requires no edge. This is a finite graph constraint; if the graph has cycles, it can license unbounded walks. For a fixed finite input stream, the candidate segmentations are finite.
design.conditional_forward_channel: Given a global injection phi from the22supplied working units to distinct source codepoints, an encodable source sequence uses only codepoints in phi's image. Remove the source word spaces, then apply phi inverse character by character. No source SPACE sign is emitted. Native display grouping is left unexplained in this necessary test: it is not identified with source words or generated by an invented formatter. The two registered orientations are forward and reversal of the entire stream, not independent word reversals or reversal of source graph edges.
design.reader_and_question: For one complete raw working-unit stream, ask whether any single global injective phi and any word-break sequence produce a message in the fixed graph language. The key must extend to all22working units, including unused ones. Preserve raw e/i multiplicities and every source position: no nulls, insertion, dy expansion, token dropping or extra ordinary-letter values. Visible group boundaries remain in provenance but do not restrict source segmentation. The output is a possible key plus complete word sequence, or a proved impossibility under the exact contract, or UNKNOWN at a cap. This is a set-valued necessary reader, not a uniquely reversible prose cipher or identified message.
design.actual_difference_from_W_plus: Every graph-legal sequence belongs to W+, but a W+ sequence can contain a missing directed pair and therefore fail the new contract. The restriction is consequential whenever the relevant edge is absent; it need not distinguish two sequences whose pairs are all admitted. Entire paths may recombine edges observed in different records, so edge membership does not imply that the resulting long passage was ever written in a source.
design.small_manual_explanation_not_a_new_contr: For a hypothetical W={a,b,ab} and E={(a,b)}, the word sequence a,b is allowed but b,a is not. The single word ab is also allowed, so the same unspaced string ab can still have two legal segmentations. This illustrates directed exclusion and remaining ambiguity only; no program, corpus count or additional test is supplied here.
design.single_character_limit: One-character words are retained. A long chain of them remains legal whenever all its directed adjacent pairs are in E. The new rule therefore does not promise to eliminate every singleton-chain interpretation, and a high proportion of singleton words is not itself an exclusion criterion.
design.whole_passage_scope: Root's selected target is the complete77original IT f75v.43–49 groups, with raw order, gaps, flags and repetitions retained in provenance. This card does not open that worksheet, choose a target word meaning, supply a native alphabet proof or pool alternate readers.

control_and_timing_distinction.GDT1408: The original32-word Deot control consisted of sorted distinct words, not a contiguous source passage. It stopped UNKNOWN at its frozen recovery gate and never reached native fitting. Its later alternative lexical certificate does not supersede that stop and is not evidence of coherent plaintext.
control_and_timing_distinction.GDT1418: The newly registered positive control selects the first stored Deot section containing at least32words and its first32consecutive unchanged words. Its full22-letter permutation and all caps are specified by root before outcomes. This is a new control appropriate to the new edge language, not a reinterpretation or retroactive repair of1408's sorted control.
control_and_timing_distinction.gate: Successful recovery of any complete legal control certificate and independent verification are required before native extraction/search. Possession of a planted key alone is insufficient. Failed or capped controls stop native work; a capped search is UNKNOWN, not UNSAT. The raw card does not assess whether any gate has passed.

registered_decision_consequences: Control failure or UNKNOWN: no manuscript conclusion, no automatic change to control, source, algorithm or budget.
Native UNSAT independently confirmed: excludes only that fixed source graph, supplied working-unit/global injective one-codepoint key and latent-boundary conjunction.

Native SAT independently certified: supplies one unassessed complete letter/segmentation/bigram candidate. The entire resulting source text must be read manually; a legal graph path is not sufficient grammar, coherent content, source identification or translated word.
Native UNKNOWN: neither compatibility nor exclusion is established. No automatic larger decoder, higher-order model or extended search follows.

prior_scope.novelty_limit: Bounded duplicate navigation found1408 and its post-stop word-star diagnostic as closest. The new content restriction is the directed attested word edge, not a new solver, longer search or wordbook. This is no claim that bigram language models are novel.
